findings.text: Device block reset service is offered for bringing a memory mapped controller through clear gate and reset sequencing with timeout reporting on failure

Reset progresses through successive clear with poll plus gate clear plus reset assert plus gate poll plus final clear poll stages and diverts to error logging when any poll exhausts its bounded retries
Clear helper writes a clear request then delays briefly and polls status until masked bits clear or retry budget ends returning success only when bits clear
Any reset poll timeout is reported through kernel error logging with device context and aborts the sequence with a timeout failure rather than using a partially reset block
General string and memory utilities are provided for ordering copy append search split scan fill and length bounded operations over null terminated sequences and raw extents
Case insensitive ordering normalizes both inputs during scan continues while characters match and neither has ended and returns signed difference reflecting first difference or equality

Bounded copy always null terminates when size allows rejects empty and excessive sizes reports truncation distinctly from success length and adapts bulk transfer to alignment mapping and sanitizer constraints before bytewise completion

Copy returns position of terminal byte append locates existing terminator before transfer bounded append guarantees termination even when count ends and sized append returns total desired length while requiring caller capacity beyond existing content

Reverse search yields last match or null token splitting replaces delimiter and advances handle with null tolerance bounded substring treats empty needle as immediate match memory scan yields first match or end address byte compare preserves ordering and width specific fills replicate value returning origin
Inverse byte search returns first position differing from target using direct scan for tiny extents and aligned prefix plus wide word compare plus suffix with replicated pattern for larger extents
Sized append treats caller capacity not exceeding current content as a programming error that triggers a diagnostic trap instead of writing beyond bounds
Two build dependent mask forms exist that preserve all but the final byte of a machine word for handling truncation during bulk transfer
Translation unit carries a marker disabling fortified checking for its string routines
Size formatting and integer list parsing helpers are provided for human readable magnitudes and for obtaining allocated arrays from kernel or user supplied text

Magnitude formatter scales block count by block size with logarithmic reduction preserving precision selects decimal or binary suffix applies rounding and spacing options and substitutes unknown label when magnitude exceeds table while zeroing output for empty input
List parsing reports absence when no values occur and allocation failure distinctly while user supplied variant duplicates input with termination and releases temporary storage on all paths

Unescape decoding handles whitespace controls octal sequences variable length hexadecimal escapes and selected symbolic escapes only when corresponding option flags allow otherwise preserving backslash literally while always terminating output and reporting produced length

Unescape scan consumes input until exhaustion or size limit emitting literal characters directly and attempting permitted decoders after an escape introducer falling back to literal backslash when no decoder accepts

Quotable duplication returns null for absent source or allocation failure and escapes control and quoting characters in hexadecimal form while command line and file variants normalize separators or resolve pathnames with fallback labels for unknown overlong or memory shortage cases

Indexed name array construction allocates pointer storage then formats each entry with numeric suffix releasing all prior entries on any failure while device managed variant registers automatic release tied to device lifecycle
Device managed string collection pairs a counted pointer to name storage with an element count consumed by the release callback

Configuration string equality tolerates a single trailing newline on either side as equivalent to exact match and indexed lookup returns first matching position or invalid argument when no entry matches or table ends early
Copy with padding fully populates destination extent copying available source bytes then filling remainder with caller pad value or truncating source when destination is smaller
Read and write overflow notification hooks accept available and wanted extents and perform no action in this configuration
Overflow diagnostic decodes routine identity and direction from reason code selects printable routine name with safe fallback and describes attempted extent versus available capacity
Fortified overflow panic emits diagnostic then halts execution and must not return to caller
Two build dependent alignment predicates exist one unconditionally reporting aligned and the other detecting unaligned address pairs by examining low address bits

User string copy masks bytes beyond terminator to avoid leaking trailing data prefers wide transfer with bytewise fallback honors caller limit and address space limit distinctly and reports fault when source exceeds accessible range
User copy entry validates count performs access checks selects masked access fast path when available else uses bounded checked region and delegates bulk work to internal helper

User length measurement aligns source expanding limit accordingly masks leading ignored bytes scans with wide zero detection then reports inclusive length overlong marker when caller limit reached or zero on fault or invalid count
User length entry rejects nonpositive limits attempts masked access path when supported else validates address against task limit and invokes checked helper within access window
User memory helpers treat access beyond task limit or fault during transfer as recoverable errors returning fault indicators rather than trapping
Diagnostic selector table associates bit positions for tasks memory timers locks tracing and blocked task categories with short names including one intentionally blank label

File scoped mask retains enabled diagnostic categories and parameter parser splits comma separated input matching each token against known names setting corresponding bits while silently ignoring unknown or empty tokens
Diagnostic mask parsing service is exposed for command line handling and returns accumulated bitmask
